title: WWE's First Triplemania Breaks Records
bodyHtml:
In a landmark moment for professional wrestling, Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's annual flagship event, Triplemanía XXXIII, shattered company records, signaling a new and prosperous chapter as the first Triplemanía since WWE's acquisition of the promotion. The show, which took place in Mexico City's Arena CDMX, drew a capacity crowd of 19,691 fans, marking the most-attended lucha libre event in Mexico this year and breaking the all-time AAA gate record.

The success wasn't limited to the live gate, as the event also set a new record for merchandise sales. The global reach of the new partnership was on full display as the show was streamed live on both WWE and AAA's YouTube channels in both Spanish and English, amassing more than 4.3 million views within its first 24 hours and hitting a peak live concurrent audience of 614,000.

Additionally, Triplemanía XXXIII generated a record 208 million views across WWE and AAA's social platforms, proving the immense demand and global appeal of the iconic lucha libre brand under its new ownership.

heroImage.alt: WWE's First Triplemania Breaks Records

title: WWE's September 20th Event to be Named WrestlePalooza; May Air on ESPN
bodyHtml:
WWE is reportedly set to revive the "WRESTLEPALOOZA" name for a premium live event on September 20, 2025. According to reports from WrestleVotes and PWInsider, the event, which has been rumored for some time, is a direct counter-programming effort against AEW's All Out, scheduled for the same night in Toronto.

This is the latest, and most aggressive, salvo in a rivalry that has intensified over the past few years. While the initial "Wednesday Night Wars" pitted WWE's developmental brand NXT against AEW's Dynamite, WWE has since used its NXT brand to go head-to-head with AEW's major pay-per-views. Examples include NXT Battleground against Double or Nothing in May 2025, and a multi-event "takeover" of Atlanta in July 2025, which included NXT Great American Bash against AEW's All In: Texas.

The decision to use a main roster Premium Live Event—potentially headlined by a high-profile match like Brock Lesnar vs. John Cena—marks a significant escalation. It forces fans to choose between two major shows and is a clear indicator that WWE is taking a more direct approach to competition.

In addition to the in-ring action, PWInsider reports that there is also talk that WRESTLEPALOOZA could air on ESPN, serving as a preview of the company's new broadcast partnership with the network, which begins in April 2026. This would further cement the event as a pivotal moment in the ongoing battle for wrestling supremacy.

heroImage.alt: WWE's September 20th Event to be Named WrestlePalooza; May Air on ESPN

title: Konosuke Takeshita Wins G1 Climax 35 Finals
bodyHtml:
In a decisive victory at the G1 Climax 35 final, Konosuke Takeshita defeated EVIL, solidifying his status as a top competitor and earning a shot at the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship. The match, which took place at the Ariake Arena in Tokyo, capped off a grueling tournament that saw both men overcome significant challenges to reach the final.

Takeshita’s journey included a hard-fought semifinal victory over IWGP World Heavyweight Champion Zack Sabre Jr., while EVIL advanced after a controversial referee stoppage win against Yota Tsuji, aided by his House of Torture stablemates. The final match was a physical and intense affair, with Takeshita showcasing his power and athleticism against the tactical and often nefarious style of EVIL.

The dynamics of the crowd at the G1 Climax 35 final were a point of intrigue throughout the event. While Konosuke Takeshita is widely respected for his in-ring talent, his dual contracts with both New Japan Pro-Wrestling and All Elite Wrestling (AEW) created a subtle divide among the Japanese audience. As an international star who is also a significant presence in AEW, some fans viewed Takeshita as an "outsider" rather than a true NJPW homegrown talent.

This sentiment led to some surprising crowd reactions, with parts of the audience at times favoring EVIL, a heel who uses constant interference and underhanded tactics, over the clearly more heroic Takeshita. This complex fan response underscored the unique position Takeshita holds as a wrestler navigating the "forbidden door" between two major promotions, as he had to win over not just his opponent but also a portion of the crowd that was hesitant to fully embrace a champion with allegiances elsewhere.

heroImage.alt: Konosuke Takeshita Wins G1 Climax 35 Finals

title: Konosuke Takeshita and Evil Heading to the Finals of G1 Climax 35
bodyHtml:
A shocking turn of events at the G1 Climax 35 semifinals saw Konosuke Takeshita defeat Zack Sabre Jr. to advance to the finals, where he'll face EVIL. Takeshita's victory is a monumental upset, given Sabre's status as the current IWGP World Heavyweight Champion and his previous dominance over Takeshita in the tournament. This win sets up a compelling finale between two of New Japan Pro-Wrestling's biggest stars.

The Road to the Semifinals

The G1 Climax 35 tournament featured 20 competitors split into two blocks, A and B, all vying for a spot in the final four. After a grueling round-robin phase, the final playoff picture was set. EVIL emerged as the A Block winner with 12 points, followed by David Finlay with 10 points. Yota Tsuji, with 10 points, secured the third and final playoff spot from the A Block.

In the B Block, Zack Sabre Jr. finished at the top with an impressive 14 points, securing a bye directly into the semifinals. The other B Block playoff spots went to Shota Umino and Konosuke Takeshita, who both finished with 12 points.

The playoffs began with two high-stakes quarterfinal matches. In the first, Konosuke Takeshita defeated David Finlay in a brutal, table-smashing encounter. Takeshita's perseverance was tested when Finlay powerbombed him through two tables on the arena floor, but he managed to beat the 20-count and rally for the victory. In the second quarterfinal, Yota Tsuji overcame Shota Umino in a hard-fought battle, earning his semifinal spot against EVIL.

The semifinal match between Konosuke Takeshita and Zack Sabre Jr. was a clash of styles, pitting Takeshita's high-impact offense against Sabre's technical wizardry. Takeshita came into the match with an aggravated knee injury, a direct result of his brutal quarterfinal bout with Finlay. This was a crucial factor, as Sabre relentlessly targeted the knee throughout the match, employing a variety of brutal submission holds.

The match was a back-and-forth affair with both men showing incredible resilience. Takeshita, despite his injury, managed to hit his signature moves, including a Poison Rana and the Power Drive running knee. However, it was a previous meeting in the G1 that was fresh on everyone's mind, where Sabre defeated Takeshita via submission. This time, Takeshita was determined to not let history repeat itself.

In the closing moments, Takeshita's power proved to be the difference. He fought through the pain and the submissions, finally landing his finisher, the Raging Fire, to put an end to the IWGP World Heavyweight Champion's G1 run. The crowd erupted as the referee's hand hit the mat for the final time, sealing Takeshita's first-ever G1 final appearance.

Takeshita's monumental victory not only avenged his previous loss to Sabre but also established him as a serious contender for the G1 Climax trophy. The stage is now set for a final showdown against the leader of the House of Torture, EVIL, in what promises to be an explosive main event to determine the winner of the G1 Climax 35. 🏆

title: Liv Morgan Injury Update
bodyHtml:
An article by Mike Johnson of PWInsider Elite has provided an update on the recovery of WWE Superstar Liv Morgan. According to the report, Morgan was scheduled for a medical evaluation this week to assess the progress of her separated shoulder, though she was not present at the recent episode of Raw as some had anticipated. The internal hope is that if her recovery remains on track, Morgan could make her return to the ring by early 2026.

This injury occurred during a June 2025 match on Raw against Kairi Sane. In the opening moments of the bout, Morgan landed awkwardly on her shoulder after a takedown from Sane. She immediately rolled out of the ring, visibly in pain and clutching her arm, and was escorted to the back by medical personnel. The match was stopped and Sane was awarded the win.

A separated shoulder, medically known as an AC joint sprain, occurs when the ligaments connecting the collarbone and the shoulder blade are stretched or torn.

Recovery time can vary significantly depending on the severity of the separation, but a serious injury like Morgan's can often require surgery and a lengthy rehabilitation process.

This isn't the first time Morgan has dealt with a shoulder issue, as she suffered a similar injury in 2023 that kept her out of action for approximately six months.

heroImage.alt: Liv Morgan Injury Update

title:
WWE/TNA DEAL INCLUDES OPTION TO BUY 
AND FIRST RIGHT TO REFUSE ANY OTHER OFFERS
bodyHtml:
Recent developments in the professional wrestling world have brought the relationship between WWE and TNA (Total Nonstop Action) back into the spotlight. A report from the Wrestling Observer Newsletter suggests that WWE has an option to purchase TNA and the right of first refusal to match any other offers. This means that if TNA were to be sold, WWE could step in and acquire the company. The report suggests that this provision is a way for WWE to ensure that any potential buyer of TNA would be "friendly" to their interests, as they wouldn't be able to turn the company into a profitable competitor.

The idea is that a new owner would secure a media rights deal, turning the company from a money-loser into a turnkey profitable company. However, if they were to compete with WWE, the deal wouldn't happen.

This move comes after the formation of TKO Group Holdings, a company created by the merger of WWE and UFC under the umbrella of Endeavor. This merger has given WWE an even larger presence in the sports and entertainment landscape. Endeavor, with its vast portfolio of media and talent management, now has a controlling stake in a company that includes both of the world's most valuable combat sports organizations.

There are also rumors swirling about a potential purchase of TNA by Lorenzo Fertitta, a former UFC head honcho. His name has emerged in recent meetings, and his past connection to the UFC, which is now part of TKO, adds another layer to this story. Fertitta and his brother Frank, along with Dana White, built the UFC into a global powerhouse before selling it to Endeavor. This history makes his potential involvement in a TNA acquisition particularly interesting, as he would have deep connections to the same company that now controls WWE.

The moves by WWE and TKO, while strategic for business growth, have raised questions about antitrust and monopoly laws. A smaller wrestling promotion, Major League Wrestling (MLW), has a pending antitrust lawsuit against WWE. MLW's lawsuit alleges that WWE has monopoly power and has used it to interfere with MLW's media rights deals and its ability to book venues. Court documents have revealed that a WWE executive spoke with a streaming service executive on the day before a deal with MLW was set to be announced, which MLW claims led to the deal falling apart. The claim is that WWE controls over 90% of the wrestling media rights revenue. These legal battles highlight the concerns that WWE's dominant position could stifle competition and prevent smaller promotions from growing. The possibility of WWE acquiring TNA through a right of first refusal would only fuel these concerns, as it would effectively prevent a strong competitor from emerging.

TNA, a company that has had an up-and-down history, has recently found a collaborative relationship with WWE. In 2024, the two companies announced a multiyear partnership that allows for talent crossovers between NXT and TNA. This has been a mutually beneficial arrangement, providing exposure to both rosters and giving fans unique viewing experiences. However, the existence of a potential purchase option for WWE suggests that this partnership could be a precursor to a full-on acquisition, solidifying WWE's place as the undisputed leader in professional wrestling.

title: WWE Looking to Help TNA Wrestling Move to a WWE Affiliated Network: To Compete With AEW on Wednesday Nights
bodyHtml:
In a move that could once again shift the landscape of professional wrestling, Total Nonstop Action (TNA) Wrestling is reportedly considering a seismic shift in its programming schedule.1 As part of ongoing media rights discussions, TNA is contemplating a move to Wednesday nights, a move that would place it in direct competition with All Elite Wrestling's (AEW) flagship show, "Dynamite."2 This potential move is not just a simple scheduling change; it's a strategic maneuver that carries with it the undertones of a larger power play, with speculation swirling about the involvement of WWE in this decision.


The news, initially reported by Sports Illustrated, suggests that TNA is in deep discussions with several platforms, with The CW and A&E emerging as potential suitors.3 The CW, which currently airs WWE's developmental brand NXT, is of particular interest.4 Sources indicate that The CW has a legitimate interest in TNA, and that some influential figures within WWE are supportive of TNA making the move to their network partner.5 While TNA President Carlos Silva has remained tight-lipped, not denying the rumors, he has stated that any decision made will be in the "best interests" of TNA, rather than a direct act of competition.6


However, this potential move is being viewed by many within the wrestling community as the latest chapter in WWE's ongoing efforts to counter-program and stifle the growth of AEW. This is not the first time WWE has made a strategic move to compete directly with AEW. When AEW launched "Dynamite" on Wednesday nights in 2019, WWE responded by moving its NXT brand from the WWE Network to the USA Network, airing live in the same time slot.7 This period, dubbed the "Wednesday Night War," saw both promotions vie for viewership in a head-to-head battle. Ultimately, NXT moved to Tuesday nights, a move that was seen by many as a concession to AEW's consistent ratings victories in the key demographics.8


Beyond the "Wednesday Night War," WWE has continued to employ counter-programming tactics.9 The company has scheduled its Premium Live Events (PLEs) on the same day as major AEW pay-per-views.10 For instance, NXT's "Great American Bash" was scheduled to run concurrently with AEW's "All In," one of AEW's biggest shows of the year.11 In another instance, a main roster WWE PLE was scheduled for the same day as AEW's "All Out."12 There are also reports of WWE considering a major event, possibly featuring John Cena, to counter-program AEW's "Worlds End" pay-per-view.13



The motivation behind these moves, according to industry observers, is to disrupt AEW's momentum and potentially impact their next television rights deal. By creating a more competitive landscape and presenting an alternative for wrestling fans, the thinking goes, WWE can potentially devalue AEW's product in the eyes of television executives. The potential move of TNA to Wednesday nights, especially with the rumored backing of WWE, is seen as a continuation of this strategy, a proxy war in the ongoing battle for supremacy in the world of professional wrestling. Whether this move will ultimately benefit TNA and what the ramifications will be for the wrestling industry as a whole remains to be seen.

heroImage.alt: WWE Looking to Help TNA Wrestling Move to a WWE Affiliated Network: To Compete With AEW on Wednesday Nights

title: REPORT: WWE Wants To Put AEW Out of Business; Establish TNA as Number 2 Promotion in the World
bodyHtml:
A bombshell report from Dave Meltzer on a recent episode of Wrestling Observer Radio has provided a startling look into WWE's alleged long-term strategy, and it's a full-court press aimed directly at All Elite Wrestling. According to Meltzer, WWE is not simply engaging in friendly competition, but is actively trying to put Tony Khan's promotion out of business.

Meltzer’s report, and the alleged motivation behind it, centers on AEW’s upcoming media rights deal. He states that WWE is afraid AEW will receive a large increase on their current US TV deal with Warner Bros. Discovery when the deal is potentially renewed in either 2027 or 2028, which would make AEW "incredibly profitable."

This fear is not without precedent. AEW's previous deal, which began in 2025, saw a massive increase from its initial contract, with reports estimating the value at $170-185 million annually. This past success in securing a more lucrative deal is what has WWE reportedly concerned that another significant increase would make AEW a permanent, and incredibly profitable, fixture in the wrestling landscape.

The latest stage in WWE 's strategy would see John Cena’s retirement match go head to head with AEW WORLD'S END. Meltzer did not mince words, having this to say “That is certainly the story that's going around that they wanted to move from December 13th to December 27th. Given all the actions and everything that has been done, of course they want to. It isn't the only thing, there is so much going on that will probably be breaking in the next couple of months when it comes to different things. They really want TNA to become the other promotion because they can control TNA. This is a major full-court press. They just want this guy [Tony Khan] out of the box and they know if the numbers stay good that he's gonna get a renewal at a much bigger number, just like they did. He's already very profitable, the number will make him incredibly profitable, and they'll never get away from him or anything like that. So they feel that they need to make sure this is the last contract.”

The report paints a picture of a calculated strategy, not just to beat AEW, but to replace them. By allegedly propping up TNA, a company that has had an on-again, off-again working relationship with WWE in the past, WWE could establish a controlled rival, rather than a truly independent one. This would effectively remove the competitive threat of a well-funded and wildly popular alternative.

For the complete breakdown and more information, you can listen to the latest episode of Wrestling Observer Radio.

title: Karrion Kross Reveals All About WWE Contract Negotiations
bodyHtml:
Karrion Kross sat down with Ariel Helwani to discuss his WWE Contract expiration, Kross confirmed his current WWE status and revealed how he had been slighted by the company during negotiations.

-Karrion Kross says he did not receive a contract offer from WWE until last Tuesday. He asked how the company came to the valuation of the offer and was not given that information. He was told he had 24 hours to agree to the offer or it would be rescinded. Kross told WWE he could not make a decision without knowing said information, and the offer was rescinded.

-Karrion Kross says that WWE did not make a contract offer Scarlett. When he asked WWE, he was told, “After we deal with you, we’ll deal with her.”

-Kross said some higher-ups in WWE thought that his post-WrestleMania 41 promo was real, and they were upset. He was under the impression that his promo had been okay’d with everyone and they all knew it was a work. One day, he waited for Triple H outside of a production meeting once he found out he wasn’t okay with it and explained everything to him.

-Karrion Kross thinks that because of Seth Rollins’ false injury and the situation with R-Truth, people don’t know now what is a work and what is real.

-He had a gut feeling all day at SummerSlam that his match with Sami Zayn would be his last in WWE: “I felt it. I even had a friend tell me, ‘You know, maybe do something for the live crowd when you’re leaving—say goodbye or something.’ I said, ‘I don’t want to be unprofessional. This moment, clearly by design, is for the babyface to get everything back that we took away from him. I don’t need to make this about myself right now. It’s about him.’”

-Karrion Kross said big promotions have reached out to him since Sunday. AEW has not, though, and he’s not surprised because people think his WWE exit is a work.

-Kross said he doesn’t have a timeline on making a decision for his future. He said he’s never felt this supported in all directions in his life. There is no sense of urgency to commit to anything that is not right for him currently. He would prefer to go back to WWE with Scarlett.

-.Says he was no longer able to directly communicate with Triple H: "I had a conversation with [Triple H] earlier in the year about all of this. They took a point man and they put him between us to communicate. Now, the point man is responsible for all the dialogue. He knows what I want to do... I've made it very, very clear that I want to keep the lanes of communication and dialogue open. It's a very weird situation. It's weird, dude."

-Kross thanks his fans for all their support:

“I absolutely cannot thank you enough. There were different periods in my life where I sincerely thought maybe I wouldn’t have even made it to this age. I was pretty troubled. And to find myself waking up with this level of support, in all directions—from friends, peers, vets, total strangers—it’s unbelievable. I just want people to know I’m not playing a game with them. This is real, and I’m here to fight. I’m going to fight to do the right thing, I’m going to fight to show up, and I’ll see you again soon.”

title: Mark Henry: “[Hulk Hogan] said, in his words, that he was a racist.
bodyHtml:
WWE Hall of Famer Mark Henry shared a candid account of his conversation with Hulk Hogan regarding the wrestling legend's 2015 racism scandal. In an interview for the TMZ documentary, "The Real Hulk Hogan," Henry recalled Hogan admitting to being a racist. Henry, who grew up as a fan, expressed his personal hurt over the admission, stating, "It hurt. I grew up watching the dude. I used to love that dude. I wanted to be like him. It hurts."

In 2015, transcripts from a private sex tape filmed in 2007 were released to the public. In these recordings, Hogan was heard using racial slurs and making offensive comments about his daughter's boyfriend. The controversy led to WWE terminating its contract with Hogan and removing all references to him from its website and Hall of Fame.

During his conversation with Hogan and then WWE Chairman Vince McMahon, Henry suggested a way for Hogan to genuinely address the fallout. He proposed a "black college tour," including stops at institutions like Morehouse and Prairie View, where Hogan could deliver a sincere apology. However, according to Henry, Hogan declined the suggestion, explaining that he had been advised not to discuss the matter further. Henry concluded that he believed this to be "bad advice."

“He said, in his words, that he was a racist. Why would I sit here and try to defend somebody that tells you who they were? It hurt. It hurt. I grew up watching the dude. I used to love that dude. I wanted to be like him. It hurts. I told him then, and I told Vince McMahon, if y’all want this to go away, I know how to fix it. We should do a black college tour at Morehouse and Prairie View and hit the circuit. Go and talk to them and be honest with your apology. He was like, ‘I’ve been advised not to talk about it no more.’ I said, ‘I think that’s bad advice,'”

heroImage.alt: Mark Henry: “[Hulk Hogan] said, in his words, that he was a racist.

title: Vince McMahon: Hulk Hogan Wasn’t Racist. He Said Some Racist Things... We All Make Mistakes.
bodyHtml:
On the "TMZ The Real Hulk Hogan" special, former WWE chief Vince McMahon addressed the fallout from Hulk Hogan's racist comments. Regarding the leaked 2015 tape in which Hogan used the N-word and said he was racist "to a point," McMahon stated, "It was unforgivable. And I was like, aghast. What happened? And when those things occurred, that's not like him. What in God's name is going on?"

He went on to describe the company's immediate reaction, saying, "As soon as it happened, obviously, the company didn’t have anything to do with him anymore. We took him out of the Hall of Fame.1 You just don’t do those things.” Despite the initial condemnation, McMahon defended the decision to reinstate Hogan back into the Hall of Fame in 2018, asserting, "I knew he wasn’t racist. I’ve been with him for so many years. He wasn’t racist. He said some racist things.2 He should pay for that, and he did. In the end, I think everyone saw the real Hulk Hogan, Terry Bollea, and they felt, ‘Wait a minute, this guy doesn’t act like a racist. He’s not a racist.’ We all make mistakes. That was a big one, but he wasn’t a racist.”

Hogan passed away at age 71 on July 26th, 2025.

heroImage.alt: Vince McMahon: Hulk Hogan Wasn’t Racist. He Said Some Racist Things... We All Make Mistakes.

This abrupt cancellation has fueled a flurry of online speculation, with rumors swirling about a serious, long-term injury and even a potential storyline involving Stephanie McMahon.

The situation was further complicated by on-air segments during "Raw" that hinted at a potentially lengthy absence for the champion, with some reports suggesting her title defense at the upcoming "Clash in Paris" event could be in jeopardy.

Amidst the silence from the company and the champion herself, a specific rumor has gained traction on social media, suggesting that Naomi, accompanied by her husband Jimmy Uso, will make an unannounced appearance with Stephanie McMahon.

It is important to note that these are only rumors and there has been no official confirmation from WWE or the parties involved. The wrestling community is now anxiously awaiting a formal update from WWE, hoping for clarity on the champion's condition and the future of the Women's World Championship.

title: LESNAR VS CENA SET FOR SEPTEMBER 20TH PLE
bodyHtml:
An unexpected announcement from WWE is set to ignite a new chapter in the company's rivalry with All Elite Wrestling. It has been reported that the planned main event for WWE's yet-to-be-announced premium live event on September 20 is a major clash between Brock Lesnar and John Cena. This event is scheduled to air head-to-head with AEW's All Out pay-per-view.

The strategic booking of Lesnar versus Cena is reportedly the reason for Lesnar's absence from the upcoming "Clash in Paris" event. Sources indicate that WWE prioritized Lesnar for this specific date as a direct method of counter-programming AEW. The move to schedule a main roster PLE on the same night as an AEW pay-per-view marks a significant escalation in their competitive tactics. Previously, the companies had squared off with WWE's developmental brand, NXT, against AEW's major events, such as NXT Battleground against AEW Double or Nothing, and NXT Great American Bash against AEW All In: Texas.

The strategy behind counter-programming is to dominate the online conversation and social media space on a night when a rival company is holding a major event. While some believe this move will only intensify the loyalty of AEW's hardcore fanbase, others contend that a marquee match-up like Lesnar vs. Cena will capture the attention of a broader, more casual audience, thereby diverting mindshare from AEW's product.

This latest booking decision suggests that WWE, under its TKO-led management, intends to continue this competitive approach.

title: KARRION KROSS REPORTEDLY GIVEN OFFER FROM WWE
bodyHtml:
The Karrion Kross Conundrum: Is WWE Working The Boys?

Wrestling fans and insiders are buzzing over the status of Karrion Kross, with conflicting reports and a veil of secrecy suggesting a potential elaborate storyline. According to wrestling journalist Dave Meltzer, the belief within WWE is that Kross will return to the company, and much of the locker room suspects the entire situation is a "work," or a fabricated storyline. This comes despite his contract reportedly expiring and his removal from the WWE active roster.

On a recent episode of Wrestling Observer Radio, Meltzer noted, "It's definitely being kept quiet. It's a weird one. There's way, way, way too much talk and the nature of the talk makes me think there's more to it." The report also stated that WWE had given Kross a new contract offer, which he had not signed as of this week, making him a potential free agent.

The situation is further complicated by Kross's media tour for his new book, Life Is Fighting, released by ECW Press. Meltzer explained, "The people who are doing interviews with him are being told...it's not WWE that's sending him on the tour, it's ECW Press, and they've basically said you cannot ask any questions regarding his contract situation, WWE situation."

While WWE talent is "pretty sceptical" about the situation, they haven't been fooled, according to Meltzer. "The belief in WWE is he's going to be back but, you know, we'll see. They are not telling anyone anything, but everyone is pretty sceptical. It's like are they working the boys on this if he comes back? You can say yes, but it's not like they're being fooled. It's not like guys are coming and going, 'Oh no, he's really gone.' No one is saying that. They're just sort of like, 'We don't know and whatever. We don't know but we figure he's going to be back and we kind of figure it's an angle, but we don't really know.'" This ambiguity has fueled speculation that the company is intentionally blurring the lines between reality and fiction to build a compelling narrative for Kross's return.

title: AEW REVOLUTION RESULTS 03-09-2025
bodyHtml:
AEW Revolution kicks off live from the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California!

ZERO HOUR: Hologram & Komander def. Lee Johnson & Blake Christian

After a back and forth match, Hologram and Komander show off their team chemistry with dual-aerial moves against Blake Christian and Lee Johnson to secure the win!

ZERO HOUR: Daniel Garcia, Adam Cole, Roderick Strong & Kyle O’Reilly def. Shane Taylor, Lee Moriarty & The Infantry

Daddy Magic joins the commentary team for this match as Adam Cole, KOR, and Roddy Strong of the Undisputed Kingdom join TNT Champion Daniel Garcia to take on ROH Pure Champion Lee Moriarty and Shane Taylor Promotions. The Opps are watching this from a private box.

This match is pure chaos as STP play the numbers game and swarm Garcia. STP starts getting a little too cocky and the teamwork of the Undisputeds shine through. Garcia locks Moriarty into the Dragontamer while staring down his own partner, Adam Cole.

ZERO HOUR: Chris Jericho vs Gravity - no contest

The match doesn’t even happen as Jericho attacks Gravity with Floyd the bat. Bryan Keith and Big Bill join in on the attack as Bandido runs in to save his brother! It doesn’t do much, as in front of Gravity & Bandido’s own mother and sister, they get attacked. Chris Jericho RIPS GRAVITY’S MASK OFF!!!

Taking advantage of Gravity covering up his face, he cannot defend himself. Aubrey Edwards leads Bandido & Gravity’s family into the ring, but Jericho picks up the bat and threatens the family.

ZERO HOUR: Big Boom AJ, Orange Cassidy, and Mark Briscoe w/ The Rizzler & Big Justice def. MXM Collection and Johnny TV w/ Taya Valkyrie

Big Justice joins Big Boom AJ while The Rizzler accompanies OC. Big Justice and the Rizzler sit ringside to watch the Zero Hour main event as Mansoor steals their double chunk chocolate cookies and throw them to the ground. OC doens’t let this stand!

Taya attempts to interfere until HARLEY CAMERON STOPS TAYA and Johnny TV gets the Powerboom. Mansoor tries to jump AJ, but BIG JUSTICE HITS A POWERBOOM ONTO MANSOOR! Mace chokeslams AJ and tries to go after Big Justice, but Briscoe, OC, and AJ hit the triple powerboom onto Mace to secure the victory!

The Murder Machines come in to try and go for the winners, but Powerhouse Hobbs comes in to even the odds!

Hangman Adam Page def. mjf

Nonpoint summarizes the differences between both men in this feud as we go right into the action. MJF tries playing mind games, but Hangman is all business! Both wrestlers go all in and use their entire arsenal against one another, but each man knows how to counter the other!

At one point, Hangman moonsaulted off the railing and flips MJF into a piledriver, but MJF flips through and then held Hanger in the piledriver position before dropping him on an open chair! Adam Page nails MJF with Angels Wings (with Max landing face first). Hanger hits the Buckshot Lariat for the victory!

TBS Championship: (C)Mercedes Mone def. Momo Watanabe

Mercedes has seemingly met her match as Momo tanks Mone’s offense and finds a way to counter everything Mercedes throws at her! Soon, though, Mercedes finds her stride and gets the better of Momo. Billie Starkz watches and takes notes from a private box.

Mone attemtps the Three Amigos, but Momo counters and does it right back! Great and VERY physical match that comes to an end as Mercedes wins via submission.

Future Title Shot: Swerve Strickland def. Ricochet

Truly, a grudge match. Swerve enters the match with aura and motivation! Prince Nana walks off. That’s okay, because Leslie Jones, Ken Jeong, and numerous celebrities are having the time of their life watching this match!

Prince Nana grabs the robe and puts in on, but Ricochet flies out and hits Nana before taking the robe back. It’s a tug of war for the robe and for the title shot. Following repeated house calls, Swerve secures the #1 contendership AND presents the Embassy robe to Prince Nana.

Continental Title: (C)Kazuchika Okada def. Brody king

Continental Title: (C)Kazuchika Okada def. Brody king

It’s a match of contrasting styles as Okada brings his technical mastery up against the brute force of Big Brody King! This was quite the physical bout. Okada pulls the switcheroo on the ref, diverting the ref’s attention with a steel chair only to use the title on Brody… except it did nothing to the beast.

However, a MASSIVE Rainmaker does the trick as Okada defeats Brody King to retain his Continental title.

AEW Tag-Team Titles: (C)Hurt Syndicate def. The Outrunners

This match was nothing short of a destruction. Shelton Benjamin out-wrestled and Bobby Lashley overpowered Truth and Turbo. Through either luck or the Syndicate getting too confident, Outrunners manage a comeback! It doesn’t last long as Lashley spears and slams both Outrunners so Shelton can secure the pinfall to retain the titles!

Nigel said if the Outrunners win the titles he would call the next Collision in his undies… At any rate, Tony Schiavone rightfully calls Lashley & Shelton the true juggernaut team that nobody will be able to stop and Excalibur agrees.

Falls Count Anywhere for Women’s Championship: (C)Timeless Toni Storm def. Mariah May

In what is called the “Hollywood Ending,” the match starts IMMEDIATELY on the ramp. Mariah May quickly takes Lutha out of the equation, but Toni Storm drops both of them off the ramp onto tables.

Toni and Mariah tape their fists and dip their hands in broken glass!!! Toni, with a crimson mask, finds… THE SHOE! This finale is truly a horror film as the women go back up the stage. As the “Queen of the Ring'“ cast and crew watch on, Toni uses the shoe to gain her payback before hitting Storm Zero on a table that says “The Hollywood Ending” to win!"

On the tron it says… “The End”

International Title: Kenny Omega def. (C)Konosuke takeshita

It’s been a long-time coming as the Alpha meets the Omega one more time. Takeshita repeatedly tries targeting the surgical scars on Omega and also distracting the ref so Don Callis can interfere.

Takeshita meticulously uses a table to damage Omega without slamming him through it. At one point, trying to slam Omega into the table legs. Kenny Omega will not stay down and fights back as the crowd chants “Fight Forever!”

Callis tries to help Takeshita avoid the One Winged Angel, but Omega doesn’t need it and manages to secure the victory AND become the NEW International Champion!!!

Steel Cage Grudge Match: Will Ospreay def. Kyle Fletcher

The match begins with an awesome scene where Ospreay and Fletcher are both on top of the steel cage, on opposite sides, and are staring each other down! It’s a bitter and bloody fight where Ospreay gets a crimson mask early on. Ospreay chops Fletcher so hard, Fletch’s chest busts open.

Each man knows how to counter the other so both guys have to get alternative and start using the cage itself as a weapon! Mark Davis uses bolt cutters to enter the cage with a duffel bag, but Ospreay kicks the door into Davis. Osrpeay pulls out a BARBED WIRE BAT from the bag.

Both guys try using it, but Mark Davis enters the ring and now it’s a 2v1 on Will. Will manages to defy the odds and get Davis back out. Fletch appears to try running away, but surprises Will with the screwdriver. It’s not enough! Will uses it on Fletch on top of the cage and then SPANISH FLY FROM THE TOP!!!

Fletch yells how much he hates Will Ospreay as Will hits the hidden blade and Tiger Driver 91 for the win!

World Championship: (C)Jon Moxley def. Cope… And Christian cage!?

Cope enters the ring as the LA crowd sings his theme song just like they did in Australia! Moxley, alone and with no Death Riders, enters the ring… alone.

Moxley breaks down Cope and yells at Jim Ross that JR saw the beginning and will watch the end of Cope. The Opps are shown watching from a private box. Cope spears Mox through the ropes as both stars start getting desperate. Mox keeps trying to work on Cope’s neck. Bryce Remsburg takes a chair away from Moxley, but Mox kicks Cope into the ref who falls to the outside. Mox wants to con-chair-to Cope, but Adam kicks the chair into Jon’s face.

Wheeler Yuta walks to the ring and is conflicted on who to go after… but hits the Busaiku Knee on Cope. Jay White runs in and attacks Yuta. Switchblade tries to use the briefcase on Mox, but Jon ducks and White accidentally nails Cope with the briefcase. Cope still gets the shoulder up! The playing field is even once more!

3 spears will do it, but a hooded figure stops the match… IT’S CHRISTIAN CAGE!!! He cashes in his contract and now it’s a 3-way match!!! Christian’s attempt was in vain as Moxley catches Christian Cage to secure the victory!

title: Lex Luger to be Inducted into WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2025
bodyHtml:
The WWE has announced that Lex Luger will be joining the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2025. This esteemed honor recognizes Luger's significant contributions to the world of professional wrestling.

Luger's illustrious career spanned over two decades, during which he competed in various promotions, including the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA), World Championship Wrestling (WCW), and the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), now known as WWE. He was a two-time WCW World Heavyweight Champion and held multiple other titles throughout his career.

The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2025 is shaping up to be an impressive one, with Luger joining previously announced inductees:

Triple H, a 14-time world champion and one of the most influential figures in WWE history

Michelle McCool, a two-time Women's Champion and one of the pioneering female wrestlers of the 2000s

The WWE Hall of Fame induction ceremony is set to take place on the eve of WrestleMania 41, with further inductees expected to be announced in the coming weeks.

Lex Luger's induction is a testament to his enduring legacy and impact on the world of professional wrestling. Fans and fellow wrestlers alike will undoubtedly be celebrating this well-deserved recognition of his contributions to the sport.

title: Breaking News: Fenix Released from All Elite Wrestling (AEW)
bodyHtml:
Fenix has been released from his contract with All Elite Wrestling (AEW), according to a report from Fightful.

According to sources, Fenix and Penta had been in discussions with WWE in 2024, with the intention of joining the company together.

However, Fenix's contractual obligations to AEW, including a significant amount of injury time, prevented him from making the move to WWE at the time. As a result, his brother Penta, joined WWE solo.

In a development that suggests Fenix may finally be joining his brother in WWE, rumors indicate that the company has already begun working on merchandise for the incoming luchador.

This move has sparked speculation that Fenix's release from AEW may be a precursor to his WWE debut.

title: Sami Zayn on His WWE Future: "I Don't Think I'm Going Anywhere"
bodyHtml:
In a recent interview with Fightful at the Elimination Chamber media junket, WWE Superstar Sami Zayn expressed his commitment to the company, hinting that he plans to stay with WWE for the foreseeable future.

When asked about his contract, Zayn responded "I'm usually kind of private about that stuff," he said, before adding, "I don't think I'm going anywhere."

Zayn, who has been an integral part of WWE's storyline in recent years, emphasized his satisfaction with his current role in the company. "I've got a good thing going here, and I see it continuing for the foreseeable future," he stated confidently.

While Zayn's comments do not provide explicit details about his contract status, they suggest that he is content with his position in WWE and plans to remain a key player in the company's future.

title: Logan Paul Claims He's Been Banned from Egypt by the Egyptian Government
bodyHtml:
YouTuber Logan Paul has made a shocking claim that he has been banned from entering Egypt by the Egyptian government. Paul revealed this information in a recent video on his YouTube channel.

According to Paul, the ban came to light when he tried to join his friend and fellow YouTuber, MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson), on a trip to explore the Pyramids. Paul explained that he had initially been invited by MrBeast to join the trip, but was later informed that the Egyptian government had specifically forbidden him from entering the country.

Paul recalled the conversation with MrBeast, saying: "MrBeast uploaded a new video exploring the Pyramids and I love the Pyramids so I was like 'Jimmy can I come?' He's like, 'for sure'. And then a week later he called me, 'unfortunately the Egyptian government said that you can't come otherwise we can't come'. And I was like wait what, I know I pissed people off, but the Egyptian government? I've never even been to Egypt. 'Why can't I come to the Pyramids Jimmy', he said, 'I don't know the government specifically said you are the only person that cannot come on this trip.'"

Paul's claim has raised questions about the reasons behind the alleged ban. While Paul has been involved in several controversies throughout his career, it is unclear what specific incident may have led to the Egyptian government's decision.

heroImage.alt: Logan Paul Claims He's Been Banned from Egypt by the Egyptian Government

title: Sonya Deville Opens Up About Shocking WWE Release
bodyHtml:
In a recent interview on "Daria & Toni Unwrapped," Sonya Deville shared a surprising revelation about her departure from WWE. Deville disclosed that she was in the midst of contract negotiations with the company at the time of her release.

"We were in the middle of negotiations, and so I thought the phone call was gonna be the middle ground that we met on, an agreement, a contract," Deville explained. However, the conversation took an unexpected turn.

"And it was, 'We are not renewing your contract'. So for complete transparency, which, this is really the first time I'm saying this, I was shocked," Deville admitted.

title: Seth Rollins Eyes Future Role in WWE Executive or Creative Position
bodyHtml:
WWE superstar Seth Rollins has revealed that conversations about his potential future role in an executive or creative position within the company have begun.

In a recent interview on Bloomberg Television, Rollins shared his thoughts on his career trajectory and his growing interest in exploring opportunities beyond his in-ring work:

"I'm closer to the end of my career than the beginning, but, you know, the end ain't here yet. So, I'm kind of in my prime right now. I'm 38 years old. My mental and physical kind of, like, locked in right now where my physical hasn't declined too much, and my mental side is really on the rise, as I'm starting to see the industry from a different angle. So that part I'm really focused on."

Rollins expressed his enthusiasm for exploring new opportunities within WWE, stating:

"I think we're in the early stages of conversations about what it might look like for me in the future in an executive or in a creative role, or whatever that may be. But again, that's in its infancy."

As one of WWE's top talents, Rollins' potential transition into an executive or creative role could bring a fresh perspective to the company's leadership.

heroImage.alt: Seth Rollins Eyes Future Role in WWE Executive or Creative Position

title: MICHIN Reveals Marijuana is Unbanned in WWE
bodyHtml:
WWE superstar Michin recently shared her secret to unwinding after a long week. In an interview on The Speakeasy Podcast, Michin revealed her go-to activity for relaxing on Saturdays.

"So before, marijuana used to be on the (WWE) drug list, and they took that off a few years ago. So when I get home on Saturdays, I'll do that, just chill out all day, and then I get back into the gym on Sunday," Michin shared.

It's clear that Michin prioritizes self-care and makes time for relaxation to recharge for the week ahead.

bodyHtml:
Dom and Liv arrive in a lowrider, which is cool until Braun Strowman and Bronson Reed brawl passed them and crash into a merch stand

Liv and Dom are out to take a victory lap after beating down Rhea and Damien last week.

Rhea comes out to announce Dominik Mysterio will be hanging above in a shark cage for Liv Morgan vs Rhea Ripley at WWE Bad Blood next Saturday

  • SAMI ZAYN DEF. LUDWIG KAISER

Simple match that saw Sami Zayn fight from under the brutish Ludwig Kaiser style.

Post match, GUNTHER runs out and he seems frustrated. He tells Sami that it's clear he really wants the World Championship match at Bad Blood. But then GUNTHER laughs, he tells Sami no and then he leaves.

The New Day is backstage and Kofi wants Xavier to go back to the old stuff with him. Xavier says that was cool when they were on top but they haven't been champs in 3 years.

Kofi says he understands. Then he says Xavier should be in charge. They're cool with each other.

American Made walks up and laughs at their efforts. So Xavier says his first play is to get a match against Them.

  • DRAGON LEE DEF. CARLITO

Pretty quick match. Dom and JD fight off the LWO on the outside until Rey comes out and surprises them.

This all distracts Carlito and allows for Dragon Lee to take the win.

The Miz wants to know why Karrion Kross has been bothering him. Karrion says he just wants the Miz to be himself again.

MIZ VS BRONSON REED NEVER HAPPENS

BRAUN STROWMAN ATTACKS BRONSON REED AND THEY TEASE SEVERAL MONSTER SPOTS THAT ARE STOPPED BY SECURITY!!!

WE NEED THIS MATCH IMMEDIATELY

Drew says Punk's family isn't the only one begging him not to get in the Cell. Drew's wife has begged Drew to get away from Punk. She can see what this is going to him.

Drew is gonna make Punk bleed.. a lot.

LAST. MONSTER. STANDING. NEXT WEEK!!!!!!

BRAUN VS BRONSON!!!!

Jade and Bianca come up to Iyo and Kairi before their match against Unholy Union. Iyo let's them know Damage CTRL is coming for the WWE WOMEN'S TAG TEAM CHAMPIONSHIPS

Viking Runes standing for WAR aired during RAW

CLEAN WIN over the New Day for American Made. This can't be good for the boys 😬

Xavier Woods and Kofi are backstage and things seem ok until the LWO walks up to clarify they didn't mean to mess things up last week.

Woods doesn't care. Says Rey should be giving advice to his son, not them. Rey says he doesn't have time for this because he has to focus on Finn Balor next week.

Woods starts crashing out. Rey and Finn are former world champs so he doesn't matter then?

Rey says you know what? Forget Finn Balor, REY VS WOODS NEXT WEEK

Whay a freaking match!! Jey Uso wins his first ever singles championship over Bron Breakker in a top notch match. Go out of your way to see it.

bodyHtml:

Pretty damn good match! OC prevents Jericho from using a foreign object and uses it on JERICHO with the Orange Punch.

Moxley, PAC, Marina and Claudio have a message for Yuta.

YUTA is not trapped in the BCC. He's free to go but he should consider he has a duty to the "greater good". He needs to show up at AEW Grand Slam next week and make a decision.

  • YUKA SAKAZAKI AND QUEEN AMINATA DEF. MARIAH MAY AND SERENA DEEB BY DQ

Mariah May wanted no real parts of this match as she wouldn't even get on the apron to tag Serena unless Mariah wanted to blind tag her.

Eventually Mariah hits Yuka with the championship because she's tired of this match. She whips on Yuka with the title until she's ready to leave.

A video plays after with Mina saying Mariah May has changed but Mina misses her and since AEW wants her back. Mina will return!

AEW attempts to play a video package for Nigel vs Bryan but it takes a couple tries to get it going 😅

"YOU'VE BEEN HERE SINCE DAY 1. FIVE YEARS AND YOURE STILL IN THE SAME SPOT.. LET ME GIVE YOU A GIFT. A LITTLE BIT OF FRICTION.. AN OBSTACLE."

Moxley is coming out for a promo with BCC when they're attacked by Private Party who are mad about being attacked last week.

WILL OSPREAY VS RICOCHET IS OFFICIAL FOR THE DYNAMITE 5TH ANNIVERSARY SHOW ON OCTOBER 2ND!!!!!!!

WILL OSPREAY, KYLE FLETCHER AND KONOSUKE TAKESHITA DEF. THE ELITE

After the match, Ospreay and Takeshita start to argue but they don't get physical at the request of Don Callis

title: WWE RAW RESULTS 09-16-2024
bodyHtml:
CM Punk opens RAW by saying he didn't mean to make a mortal enemy when he came back to WWE but he apparently has in Drew McIntyre.

Punk says Drew made a mistake in not finishing the job. But now things are different. People ask Punk how many Hell in a Cell matches does he actually have left in him?

The honest answer is zero. His family has asked him not to do this and an angel on his shoulder is begging him not to do this.

But he wants everyone to know why he's going to do it anyway. If you push Punk far enough he can become the devil himself. And now the devil is here.

The devil in Punk's heart tells Punk this only ends at Hell in a Cell. The same heart that Drew McIntyre swore he would make stop beating.

But Punk isn't going to promise that he can kill Drew McIntyre. He can only promise that Drew MCINTYRE is going to have to kill PUNK because Punk is prepared to die and if this is the end, his career was great. So be it.

If Drew McIntyre is prepared the way Punk is, then Punk will see McIntyre in hell.

"Tonight, Pete Dunne, you become my Butch."

- Sheamus to Pete Dunne

  • PETE DUNNE DEF. SHEAMUS

Sheamus and Dunne have a really stuff back and forth. Sheamus does take most of the match as the larger opponent, until Dunne tries to use a sheleighly.

The ref catches him, and Dunne uses a Cricket Bat instead 🏏

Jey Uso is talking to Rhea and Damien when Xavier Woods walks up and makes amends with Damien and Rhea.

Woods says he's gonna be fighting Judgement Day for the WWE TAG TEAM CHAMPIONSHIPS. Priest says New Day better make sure they get those titles tonight

Miz is offended Braun Strowman told him he couldn't take Bronson. Strowman shows Miz the injury Bron left him with and says he meant no offense. He's just a big monster and Miz is not.

  • NATALIA DEF. ZOEY STARKS

Jey Uso is out for a match with Strowman but he's interrupted by Bron Breakker. Breakker tells Jey Uso they're different because Bron didn't need no Bloodline. No cousins. No uncles.

The only family Bron needs is the Intercontinental Championship. He fights for the title and the title fights for him(?)

The IC title match is made official for next week. Bron snuffs Jey, USO goes down and Bron tries to hit the rebound spear but Jey Uso gets him with a spear first.

"IM TIRED OF THIS.... SOMETHING’S GOTTA CHANGE, MAN."

XAVIER WOODS HAS WALKED OUT ON KOFI KINGSTON

  • WWE TAG TEAM CHAMPIONSHIPS: JUDGEMENT DAY DEF. THE NEW DAY

New Day was looking good until the rest of Judgement Day came out to distract Kofi. Kofi leaves the ring, the ref leaves the ring. JD and Finn jump Xavier.

JD puts Xavier in a chokehold, Finn hits the stomp at the same time. Kofi comes back after it's over but it's too late and Xavier has had ENOUGH

Xavier Woods is backstage screaming at the LWO for coming down and brawling with the Judgement Day during their tag team championship match. Woods says they cost him the tag titles.

Kofi walks up and let's Woods know Kofi asked them to come. Xavier ask why the hell would Kofi not TELL HIM??!

DOES KOFI THINK THE NEW DAY IS NO GOOD WITHOUT BIG E? Kofi doesn't get to respond, Woods walks off.

THAT WAS FREAKING AWESOME 😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭

BRAUN STROWMAN VS BRONSON REED GOES TO A NO CONTEST AFTER AN INCREDIBLE BRAWL

Sami Zayn comes out to call Gunther out for ducking him since Sami beat him at Wrestlemania. But Ludwig Kaiser will not let anybody disrespect his bro like this.

Kaiser asks what does Sami even think he's doing asking for World Title shots? Why would Gunther be scared of Sami when he's the most dominant force in the company.

If anything, Gunther is trying to protect him from a beat down. Sami wants to talk about WrestleMania but miracles never happen twice and Sami will never ever beat GUNTHER again.

Sami asks why isn't Gunther out here himself? Gunther doesn't need Kaiser to speak for him. Gunther doesn't need Kaiser for anything at all But Sami actually doesn't think Kaiser needs GUNTHER either.

Kaiser turned on Vinci to stand on his own two feet, like anybody else. But does he think he's gonna get respect being Gunther's mouth piece?

If KAISER wants to talk to Sami, he doesn't need to speak through GUNTHER. He should grow some balls and speak for himself.

GUNTHER has heard enough. He walks up to his own friend Kaiser and asks if Kaiser has anything to tell him? He should say it right now.

Kaiser says he does have something to say and he's been trying to get it off his chest for a very very long time...

Then he attacks Sami. They tell Sami the answer is still no. Gunther leaves but Sami knocks Kaiser out of the ring and stands tall in the end.

ABSOLUTE. BANGER.

  • IYO SKY DEF. BIANCA BELAIR

Just an excellent back and forth. Even the finish was a counter of a counter of a counter.

Iyo reverses Bianca's 450 Splash. Iyo goes for the moonsault and Bianca grabs her for the KOD instead, but Iyo maneuvers that into a roll up victory!!!

title: WWE SMACKDOWN ON USA RESULTS 09-13-2024
bodyHtml:
New logo. New music. Triple H opens Smackdown by saying he can't believe it's been 25 years since he main evented the first episode.

Hunter introduced the new era of Smackdown with pyro and some flames for the lowering steel cage as Cody vs Solo Sikoa opens the show.

  • WWE CHAMPIONSHIP STEEL CAGE MATCH: CODY RHODES DEF. SOLO SIKOA

Classic story told here of a champion trapped in a Cage with a monster. Cody does eventually overcome Solo with a clean Cross Rhodes.

Solo Sikoa's best match so far.

The Bloodline are jumping Cody when ROMAN REIGNS RETURNS

Roman clears house until the numbers game catches up. He's able to fight em off anyway and then he calls out Jacob Fatu.

But Solo won't let it happen. The Bloodline starts attacking Roman again when Cody jumps in to save him.

Cody and Roman have a moment face to face before Jacob puts the Ula Fala on Solo and gets Roman's attention.

Nick Aldis says Jacob Fatu and Solo Sikoa have an offer that he can't refuse.

But it seems the Wyatt6 have something in mind for Smackdown now 👀

  • MICHIN DEF. PIPER NIVEN

After the match, they jump MICHIN and Chelsea hits an UnprettyHER onto a trash can.

Kevin Owens choice for a tag team partner could not make it so he grabs a dude named Ricky from the back to help out(Ricky Gibson of the Northwest circuit)

Theory and Waller are laughing at KO

A production person tells Kevin his partner WAS able to make it. KO says sorry and gives Ricky a stunner.

And then it's revealed to be Randy Orton.

  • KEVIN OWENS AND RANDY ORTON DEF. A TOWN DOWN UNDER

Very fun tag match. Orton and Owens have so much fun together

Nick Aldis has a contract for Solo Sikoa and Jacob Fatu v Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns at Bad Blood

Solo and Jacob have agreed, but Cody tells Aldis he wants nothing to do with The Bloodline and that it’s Roman Reigns’ problem.

Nia Jax is out to say that Nick Aldis informed her she'll be defending the Women's Championship at Bad Blood.

BAYLEY comes out to say she wants a shot at the title. BAYLEY tells Nia she can't win without Tiffy. Tiffany Stratton runs out. Nia tells BAYLEY they're gonna jump her right now.

Naomi runs out for the save.

Except she also wants the Women's Championship 👀

Nia suggests Bayley and Naomi vs Nia and Tiffy next week. The person who pins Nia will get a shot at the title.

But if Nia and Tiffy win, the person who gets pinned will have to leave Smackdown permanently.

  • ANDRADE DEF. CARMELO HAYES (3-2)

Andrade has earned a shot at the United States Championship. LA Knight comes out to tell Andrade what he's won isn't much a prize.

All he's won is a ass whopping next week on Smackdown

Jade Cargill and Bianca Belair are doing an interview when Nia and Tiffy step up. Nia asks if they saw what happened to Naomi?

They say no. Nia says it hasn't happened yet. Next week. But she reminds them that she beat them both on the way to the Queen of the Ring and if they get in her business, she'll come after them next.

Roman Reigns is back out. He says he doesn't need Cody because this is family business.

Many things have changed by Roman hasn't . This is still Roman's show and Roman's WWE.

Cody comes out now. He says it USED to be Roman's show. But it hasn't been since WrestleMania.

They're going to fight when Solo Sikoa interrupts them. The Tama and Tanga try to ambush Roman and Cody. They're both taken out fairly quickly.

Solo asks if they're friends now?? Roman ignores them... he signed the contract. Cody steps over and signs the contract.

ROMAN AND CODY VS SOLO AND JACOB AT BAD BLOOD

title: AEW Dynamite Results 09-11-2024
bodyHtml:
"Diplomacy has failed. Today, I choose war."

- Jon Moxley just declared war on AEW. Their reason for taking Bryan out is that he doesn't have the stomach for what comes next. Bryan tried to fix AEW with empathy and understanding. Bryan tried a Diplomatic approach.

Moxley will not do the same.

Christian is out to let Bryan know that he's still in Christian’s sights.

Christian says he's going to beat Bryan so bad that Bryan will wish Brie was the one with CTE!

Kip Sabian seemed to be watching from the crowd for some reason.

Don Callis comes up to Will Ospreay to offer him an opportunity to team with Kyle Fletcher in the Tag Team Gauntlet match tonight. Ospreay is hesitant but he accepted..

Konosuke Takeshita is NOT HAPPY with this situation.

“People like me are crucified in this life so that we can be worshiped in the next.” –Jack Perry

  • TNT CHAMPIONSHIP: JACK PERRY DEF. LIO RUSH

Arrive. Win. Leave.

Hangman says he's after anybody who stood in the middle of him and Swerve Strickland. He walks down the corridor but nobody will look at him the same after the cage match last week

Jeff Jarrett walks up to Hangman. He says the Jarrett family has seen many men fall down this kind of dark path in the last 20 years of promoting.

Jarrett also reminds Hangman that he owes him for going after Karen. Hangman flips out and attacks.

Hangman's unhinged and he's losing himself.

Private Party and Komander think they're going to have a match but BCC ATTACKS.

PAC picks up a mic as Mox, Claudio and Marina Shafir clean house.

PAC says AEW is broken. What happened to Bryan was inevitable. But what they did to him was inevitable as well. The prophesy is fulfilled and AEW belongs to them.

PAC says he's been lost for a long time. But he's found a home now. BCC leaves.

  • RICOCHET DEF SAMMY GUEVARA

Awesome match that goes exactly how you think it would. A huge athletic showcase and a win for Ricochet as he climbs the ladder towards Will Ospreay.

Ricochet gets attacked by Beast Muertos after and Sammy reluctantly gets in the ring for the save.

Okada is doing an interview with Renee about how easy it was to win the Fatal Four Way at All Out. He's approached by Callis and Takeshita.

Takeshita wants a shot. Okada says Takeshita will be Champ some day. But NOT the Continental Champion

Darby calls out Jon Moxley. Mox comes out and Darby has a story for him. Darby says he was looking for heroes when he first joined pro wrestling but all the ones he found were fake.

Except for Mox. Until the day Mox took out his supposed "brother" Bryan Danielson. Darby would never do something like that and Darby would never associate with someone like that. So what does Mox want.

Mox doesn't have time to explain to Darby what is going on but he loves Darby, he's never lied to Darby and he needs Darby to trust him and give up his World Title shot.

Darby asks if Mox has been drinking again. He has to earn that shot like anybody else.

Mox says Bryan will NOT be wrestling at Grand Slam after what they did to him. So Mox WILL earn it...

JON MOXLEY VS DARBY ALLIN AT GRAND SLAM

Nigel McGuinness needs to speak to Tony Khan immediately. Tony Khan WILL want to hear this.

What is he cooking?

  • MARIAH MAY DEF. QUEEN AMINATA

Hard hitting match. Aminata really showed her worth here.

Post match, Mariah lays in the ring near tears. None is this is worth it because it's missing something. It's missing someone...

MIMA SHIRAKAWA. PLEASE COME HOME.

title: WWE RAW RESULTS 09-09-2024
bodyHtml:
• 8 PERSON STREET FIGHT: WYATT6 DEF AMERICAN MADE

CHAOS. With zero structure for the first few minutes. Absolute Mayhem. Very fun.

American Made takes out the members of the Wyatt6 through various means until Joe Gacy is alone. They jump him with Kendo sticks until Ivy Nile goes under the ring and finds Nikki Cross.

Rowan digs his way out from under the debris they buried him under. He RIPS OUT the barricade and uses it as a shield/weapon. And now it's Rowans turn to get jumped by American Made.

AM has the advantage until Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis wake back up to even the odds.

Chad Gable with an Angle Slam off the top rope through a table on Joe Gacy!!!!! Gable puts Gacy in an ankle lock while Ivy Nile attacks him with Kendo sticks.

THEN NIKKI CROSS DELIVERS A GERMAN TO CHAD GABLE!!!!

**CENSORED HOLY SH*T CHANTS**

Uncle Howdy is finally involved. He distracts Gable, allowing Rowan to chokeslam Gable onto steel steps.

Howdy hits Gable with the Sister Abigail. Lumis hits Gable with a splash.

Wyatt 6 gets the win!!!

WHAT A FREAKIN OPENER FOR MONDAY NIGHT RAW

WWE RAW RETURNS TO TWO HOURS FROM OCTOBER 7TH THROUGH THE END OF 2024!!

This is the period of time that WWE RAW would have been with no home until the Netflix deal begins.

WWE negotiated with USA to keep RAW until January and it appears this was the compromise.

Finn Balor vs Damian Priest is officially on for WWE Bad Blood.

Balor cut a promo blaming Priest for his inability to capture the world title. Basically called Priest a secret hater that was supposed to be a bro.

Priest is out to accept a fight between them at Bad Blood and he says he knows the JD Playbook. He fends off a surprise attack from the rest of the group for a while until the numbers game catches up. Rhea runs out but they both get whipped.

Jey Uso finally comes out to help clear the ring. He took a while tho.

  • WWE WOMEN'S TAG TEAM CHAMPIONSHIPS: JADE CARGILL AND BIANCA BELAIR DEF. UNHOLY UNION

Bret Hart is out to promote tickets for Survivor Series that go on sale this Friday.

GUNTHER comes out and says Bret used to be the best there was. But the best there is and the best there ever will be? That's GUNTHER now.

Gunther tells Bret that he will always be number two to GUNTHER's favorite wrestler. BILL GOLDBERG.

This brings out Sami Zayn who won't tolerate that kind of disrespect to the Canadian hero. A brawl breaks out. Gunther decided to walk away.

  • DOMINIK MYSTERIO DEF. DRAGON LEE

Really good match that got better as it went on. Liv gets involved and Dom pulls out the win with a beautiful frog splash.

  • SURPRISE PARTNER NATALYA, ZELINA VEGA AND LYRA VAKYRIA DEF. PURE FUSION COLLECTIVE

Drew McIntyre is out to cut a promo about how Punk touching some corners and claiming to have a victory over him is false. But it doesn't matter now because he beat Punk down and he'll never have to see him again.

Adam Pearce comes out and says he's spoken to CM Punk and they've agreed. Drew and Punk, Hell in a Cell.

  • REY MYSTERIO DEF. FINN BALOR BY DQ

Balor put Mystero in a single leg, Boston crab, while he was draped over the second and third rope, and didn’t let go.

He was disqualified, then drop kicked Mysterio into the LED board outside after the match.

heroImage.alt: WWE RAW RESULTS 09-09-2024

title: AEW ALL OUT 2024 RESULTS
bodyHtml:
• MJF DEF. DANIEL GARCIA

The story of this match is both men are trying to break each other's necks. Simple stuff. MJF attacks the wound from the champagne bottle on Dynamite to bust Garcia open. MJF tries to tombstone Garcia off the top rope again but Garcia reversed into a sick DDT.

MJF spits a nasty loogie into Garcia’s face. This baits Garcia into a rage again giving MJF the upper hand.

Great back and forth until MJF puts Garcia in a Walls of Jericho, a reference to both of their history with Jericho. Garcia reversed into a Yes Lock which could be taken as both a reference to both of their wins over Bryan AND the fact that maybe Garcia should've went with Bryan instead of Jericho.

MJF lowblows Garcia and rolls him up for the win.

MJF tries to shake Garcia's hand and go for the low blow again. Garcia is prepared. He lowblows MJF.

Takes him to the corner. Spits in his face and PILEDRIVER OFF THE TOP ROPE TO MJF.

  • AEW WORLD TAG TEAM CHAMPIONSHIPS: THE YOUNG BUCKS DEF BLACKPOOL COMBAT CLUB

The story of this tag match is that Blackpool Combat Club are completely capable of taking the Tag Team Championships from the Young Bucks. But the Bucks are using every cheap truck they can think of which is JUST ENOUGH to keep their heads above water and their shoulders off the mat.

Eventually they're able to get onto even ground with BCC. And BCC may have even gotten a bit cocky in their own ability.

Claudio throws Wheeler Yuta for the Fast Ball Special but Matt Jackson reversed with knees up into a roll up pin.

Great match.

  • AEW INTERNATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP: WILL OSPREAY DEF. PAC

Prior to the match, Ospreay suggested that he had overlapped PAC without even realizing it.

PAC and Ospreay begin the match showcasing their entirety equal skill. But PAC eventually inches away, gaining the advantage on Ospreay by reversing Ospreay’s reversals.

Ospreay evens the match back up. And both men are now countering each other very frequently.

PAC begins attacking Ospreay's wrapped up neck with a German Suplex on the apron AND a poisonrana on the apron.

Ospreay does eventually inch a bit further than PAC. Finally reversing one of PACs poisonranas and hitting the Super Oscutter and the Hidden Blade to pin PAC.

  • CHICAGO STREET FIGHT: KRIS STATLANDER DEF. WILLOW NIGHTENGALE

The former friends hatred had been developing on TV for months. So when this match begun, it was time for WAR.

Kris Statlander and Stokely Hathaway would use their numbers advantage over Willow, as they've been doing for weeks now. Willow digs deep and proves that her love for Statlander isn't going to keep her from getting violent.

Unfortunately, Willow’s heart does eventually take over. In one last moment of embrace between the girls, Kris takes advantage and hits Staterday Night Fever for the win.

Will Ospreay calls out Ricochet to climb the ladder and come after the International Championship.

  • AEW CONTINENTAL CHAMPIONSHIP: KAZUCHIKA OKADA DEF. ORANGE CASSIDY, KONOSUKE TAKESHITA AND MARK BRISCOE

We're off to the races immediately in this clash of styles. Okada and Takeshita try to clear the ring and face off but the fans will have to wait a little longer for that as Orange Cassidy won't be forgotten.

We're treated to periods of each pair of wrestlers facing off in the ring. The Conglomeration members OC and Briscoe team up before facing off.

Takeshita and Okada finally fight one in one for a few minutes.

Eventually Briscoe and Cassidy get back in the ring. Takeshita takes the advantage but throws him out of the ring. Murders Mark Briscoe and takes Orange Cassidy for himself. Rainmaker for the win.

  • TBS WOMEN'S CHAMPIONSHIP: MERCEDES MONE VS HIKARU SHIDA

Mercedes comes into this match with a chip on her shoulder as she tries to erase a lauded All In performance.

Hikaru Shida is the perfect person to be in the ring with if redeeming yourself is the goal.

These two ladies were VERY SNUG tonight. Lots of aggression and SUPER STIFF shots.

Eventually these stiff shots lead to some miscommunication as Shida KNOCKS THE SH*T out of Mercedes with a Katana. So bad that Mercedes can't stay down for the pin and rolls out after a one count.

They get back in the ring and take it home but clearly there was a miscommunication at the end.

AEW WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP: BRYAN DANIELSON DEF JACK PERRY

But the story of the match doesn't matter as much as the post match. The Elite is attacking Bryan. Killswitch is out to herald the arrival of Christian Cage who wants to cash in his contract.

Randy walks up and asks isn't that the guy that killed Seth Rollins? Randy then hyped Miz up and let's him think he has a chance against Reed.

bodyHtml:
**ORTON VS GUNTHER IS ON FOR BASH AT BERLIN**

GUNTHER opens WWE RAW with some pyro.

Gunther says if you think what he did with the IC title was historic, just watch and see what he's going to do as the World Heavyweight Champion.

SMACKDOWN'S RANDY ORTON INTERRUPTS THE WORLD CHAMPION.

GUNTHER says he's not easily surprised but Randy's music caught him off guard. Orton says Gunther didn't pin his shoulder to the mat in the KotR final. So he's challenging GUNTHER for the World Championship.

Sheamus says he doesn't know why everyone wants a piece of him but he's ready for all of it. He's been challenged by Ludwig Kaiser up next.

  • SHEAMUS DEF. LUDWIG KAISER

Kaiser attacks Sheamus during his entrance to begin the match. Sheamus eventually fights back into control until Kaiser fakes a rib injury.

Pete Dunne tries to attack Sheamus again and fails. But this isn't enough to keep Sheamus from getting the win.

WWE plays a video package acknowledging that 11 Years Ago in Baltimore, the site of tonight's RAW, is where the original Wyatt family debuted.

Damien Priest rushes down to th ring and calls out Finn Balor to get the beating he deserves. Priest says the Judgement Day were the first group to accept him and make him feel like a family.

But he doesn't need them anymore because he has the fans as his family now. And Balor made Priest let his family down.

Balor comes on the screen and says Priest forgot what Judgement Day was about. They're supposed to look out for each other without leaders.

Balor remembers a year ago when Damien Priest couldn't help BALOR win the World Championship. Priest told Balor he needed to man up.

So Balor waited. And now he manned up. Balor will take Priest out when Balor is ready. But Balor won't be alone.

He’ll have the new Judgement Day behind him

Bronson Reed wants to know how Sheamus got a match this week when he got pinned by Reed? Priest has an excuse but Reed doesn't want to hear any of it.

Reed says he'll make his own path to the top

  • LYRA VALKYRIA DEF. SHAYNA BASLER BY DQ

Sonya DeVille and her group jump Lyra mid match. Until Damage CTRL comes out to clear the ring.

CM Punk talks about why he's always smiling since he returned.

CM Punk says he's still smiling because even tho he lost. He came back from injury early and the fans still love him.

Punk says his Summer of Hate hasn't gone the way he expected but it's still Summer.

Seth Rollins interrupts Punk dressed EXACTLY like Hangman Adam Page. He wants to fight Punk but Drew McIntyre interrupted them both.

Punk chases Drew off and Rollins gets attacked by BRONSON REED.

REED GIVES ROLLINS 3 SAMOAN DROPS AND 6 TOP ROP TSUNAMI SPLASHES.

NO WAIT… SEVEN TOP ROPE TSUNAMI SPLASHES. OH MY GOD WHAT A SEGMENT

AUTHORS OF PAIN VS NEW DAY GOES TO NO CONTEST

ODYSSEY JONES HAS ARRIVED TO MONDAY NIGHT RAW OVER A YEAR AFTER BEING DRAFTED TO THE BRAND

JONES TAKES OUT KARRION KROSS AND THE AUTHORS OF PAIN ALL ON HIS OWN AND APPEARS TO JOIN THE NEW DAY

Kofi Kingston introduces Odyssey Jones to Xavier Woods. Woods feels uncomfortable because he didn't know they even knew each other.

Before he can say something about it, Alpha Academy comes in because TOZAWA wants to show Xavier Woods his new dance.

Comic relief match that saw the Miz and R-Truth working like the Rock N Roll Express for a bit.

Damien Priest and JD McDonough actually have a pretty damn good match until the rest of Judgement Day gets involved.

They're beating on Damien Priest and he's able to fight off Carlito, JD and Balor and Liv and Dom are jumping Priest when Rhea finally arrives.

Rhea runs out and gets her hands on Liv for a minute until Dom steals Liv away. Rhea and Priest take the left behind JD McDonough and destroy him in the ring.

Incredible crowd. Incredible segment.

Sonya DeVille and her group take out Dakota Kai so that there won't be a match tonight. But Iyo Sky takes Dakota’s place in the match.

  • IYO SKY DEF. SONYA DEVILLE

Damage CTRL and the rest of Sonya’s group brawl at ringside and this gives Iyo an opening to defeat Sonya.

CHAD GABLE AND THE CREED BROS ARE OFFICIALLY KNOWN AS..... AMERICAN MADE.

Great showing from both teams.

This is now the AEW American Championship to represent "the best country in the world"

MJF vs Will Ospreay 2 is set for All In at Wembley Stadium!!!!

KAMILLE HAS FINALLY ARRIVED IN AEW!!!!

KAMILLE ATTACKS BRITT FROM BEHIND! KAMILLE IS ALIGNED WITH MERCEDES MONE

FINALLY!!

Otis tells Chad Gable that he's glad he's ok but Chad Gable is NOT part of their family anymore.

Absolutely incredible segment here. WWE plays the VHS tape that Abby the Witch gave them.

It's Uncle Howdy interviewing Bo Dallas about the death of Bray Wyatt!

"Don't you think you're exploiting your brother's legacy?"

Bo Dallas says nobody could ever understand what he feels. What was he supposed to do? Let Bray Wyatt's legacy become a mossoleum??

Nothing will ever matter anymore. But the WYATT6 will never let them forget

bodyHtml:

bodyHtml:
WWE Clash at the Castle is live from Glasgow, Scotland.

  • WWE CHAMPIONSHIP I QUIT MATCH: CODY RHODES(c) DEF. AJ STYLES

Cody and AJ kick the match off by brawling to the backstage area to the international announcers area.

They’re back in the Arena when AJ Styles hits a brainbuster on Cody onto the announce table.

Camera cuts to AJ Styles arguing with Cody Rhodes and when it cuts back to Cody... HES BUSTED OPEN BAD!!!!!!!!

MASSIVE *F**K YOU AJ* CHANTS!!

AJ Styles brings out handcuffs which gets a Kinky Bastard chant and he beats on Cody with a Kendo stick. Cody's mom distracts AJ long enough for Cody to get his self back together.

AJ is busted open. Cody handcuffs AJ to the ropes. Beats him with a chair and threatened to hit him with steel steps.

AJ QUITS.

CODY HITS HIM ANYWAY.

Cody is attacked by the Bloodline until Randy Orton and Kevin Owens come out to even the odds.

Pretty fun match that really fell apart in the final minutes.

Excellent wrestling match sprinkled with all the drama of one of WWE's best ongoing stories.

At one point Chad Gable is berating Maxxine for not whacking Sami with the IC Belt off a distraction.

Otis will not allow this and gets in Gable's face. Later, Gable gets thrown into Maxxine's bad ankle. Otis has had enough of Maxxine getting hurt. He takes her and leaves. This distraction allows Sami to hit Gable with the Helluva Kick to win.

Great showing for both Bayley and Piper Niven tonight. Chelsea gets ejected early on allowing this to be a straight up back and forth match for the most part.

Chelsea does make her way back out under a mask to distract the ref and cost Bayley a pinfall. But it wasn’t enough to help Piper win

Punk kicks McIntyre in the balls and costs him the World Championship
